mintAuthority.summary: USDe native Ethereum issuance uses EthenaMinting V2 signed-order flows, but the 86,400-second owner/default-admin timelock can replace the token minter with an arbitrary address whose USDe.mint needs no collateral or durable supply bound. Its 5-of-10 Safe root and one-day delay fail governed issuance gates. The 200,000,000 USDe per-block setting is a rate limit, not a durable bound; periodic third-party backing reconciliation yields unbounded-reconciled.

controls.label: EthenaMinting V2 token minter contract
controls.capDescription: EthenaMinting V2 enforces a 200,000,000 USDe global mint maximum per Ethereum block; the separate default-admin timelock can change that limit.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711751, USDe minter() returned this direct-deployment EthenaMinting V2 contract and globalConfig() still returned globalMaxMintPerBlock=200,000,000 USDe and globalMaxRedeemPerBlock=10,000,000 USDe. Verified source confines MINTER_ROLE callers to the capped mint entrypoints; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can change caps and role membership. A separate aggregated issuer-backend control records the 20 active MINTER_ROLE EOA callers; complete role-event replay through block 25576200 plus zero RoleGranted or RoleRevoked logs from block 25576201 through 25711751 established that the cohort remained current at the observation block. MINTER_ROLE can invoke mint paths but cannot change the 200,000,000 USDe cap; the default-admin timelock can change it. The 86,400-second TimelockController is both the current USDe token owner and EthenaMinting V2 default admin, while the 5/10 Ethena Safe holds the timelock's proposer and canceller roles.

controls.label: EthenaMinting V2 MINTER_ROLE signer cohort
controls.capDescription: The cohort invokes EthenaMinting V2's signed-order flow, which enforces a 200,000,000 USDe global mint maximum per Ethereum block.
controls.evidence: The complete role-event replay through Ethereum block 25576200 resolved 20 active MINTER_ROLE EOAs: 0x03984ddef40850bb9862ec09037853630d7b6ae4, 0x0b23d23939a1731289eaa04f62ba1dd4ecdd5c7d, 0x24be9948466feceb22a9b77b19e404f2119fb962, 0x4d394f45dfadef5522759c511702db97690a5c12, 0x57093ffedc2f49eb3a5a11b63c0f4ca1b75c5cb7, 0x57fefb75863cc64fecf11ac99d7a5b60ebe0080f, 0x64004ae464f49c30a188c34e01b0dc66c8beb21e, 0x655a1b0124b39b2d7c7f62a99627a891fad93b7b, 0x661ca83074b8ec630825d4604455325499f951a1, 0x6f1d2df2acc5f2da3167ad1967b648207cfc63db, 0x6fd5ffee1220b0458c2114d6ce7fb4de2bc8fee6, 0x71c95aaa22696d745e378486b769ee47ca23797c, 0x7d69817ea29244504c1a97b66e2c990f25df7599, 0x950c886cc6b9d420455985c3d31090aa060e96c8, 0x9b6889199627f78470ea230cc7df974239e0a5e5, 0xa22c29b20f9be2c809979ed606b24fe5286ac8f2, 0xb229d6db056750e22499191156bf4c3654df3826, 0xc3309fddfc8297c39a38d5d872a37222f98dad37, 0xcd992cfb025014c01ebc2f2311c3f87aa8411d9c, and 0xd0899998cceb5b3df5cdcfaadd43e53b8e1d553e. Incremental Blockscout queries returned zero RoleGranted and zero RoleRevoked events from block 25576201 through 25711751, so this cohort remained current at the observation block. Every caller uses EthenaMinting V2's capped signed-order mint path and no cohort member can change globalConfig or role membership; the separate 86,400-second default-admin timelock can change role membership and the global mint limit. A fresh complete Blockscout role-event replay through Ethereum block 26095798 returned 40 grants and 20 revocations, resolving the same 20 active addresses. Pinned hasRole(MINTER_ROLE,address) calls at that block returned true for all 20, including the corrected 40-hex-digit identity 0x64004ae464f49c30a188c34e01b0dc66c8beb21e; the prior text omitted its final hexadecimal digit.

controls.label: Ethena governance Safe (timelock roles)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711751, USDe owner() returned the timelock rather than this Safe. The Safe still had a 5-of-10 threshold and no enabled modules; Safe API reported guard 0x74abe7805541c28f31953b3cda9711dc96278d29. On-chain reads confirmed this Safe still has the TimelockController proposer, canceller, and executor roles. It can propose a timelocked USDe setMinter(address) or EthenaMinting cap change, but does not directly own the token.

controls.label: EthenaMinting V2 default-admin timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711751, this 86,400-second TimelockController was USDe owner(), held EthenaMinting V2's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and could change mint caps and role membership or call owner-only setMinter(address). The 5-of-10 Ethena Safe held its proposer, canceller, and executor roles.

review.evidence: Mint/bridge boundary review completed 2026-08-16: Ethereum is the sole reviewed native USDe issuance route; OFT adapters and satellite representations are assessed under Bridge Risk. Historical block 25711751 resolved owner/default-admin to Timelock 0xe8dc0fab349ea169283c48ccfd09d797e6db7c94 and proposer/canceller/executor to the 5-of-10 Ethena Safe. Complete role-event replay through block 25576200 plus no changes through 25711751 established the recorded 20 MINTER_ROLE EOAs at that observation, not a refreshed cohort today. The July 1, 2026 publication for June described monthly reports from integrated custodians and an independent third-party backing assessment; reconciliation remains periodic and supervision attestation-only, with no named prudential supervisor evidenced. The 2026-10-01 documentation discrepancy (5/11 versus on-chain 5/10) remains historical. D14/D29 sweep 2026-10-03 at Ethereum block 26113561 (hash 0xf8669491a2d5c3e0dfe4c4233ed6861dcbe45f046fac9804a60c40ae5ee6846e): owner() and minter() remain the timelock and EthenaMinting V2 0xe3490297a08d6fc8da46edb7b6142e4f461b62d3; the timelock holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and getMinDelay() is 86400. Verified USDe.setMinter(address) has no collateral-admission constraint, and USDe.mint(address,uint256) checks only that caller equals minter, so authorization can create durable unbacked supply for a chosen recipient. D14 is unbounded independently of upgradeability. globalConfig() reads 200,000,000 USDe/block mint and 20,000,000 USDe/block redeem: these are rate limits, not durable total-supply caps. Safe threshold/owners remains 5-of-10 and hasRole confirms proposer/executor/canceller. D29 G1 fails because the root is a Safe rather than on-chain token voting; G2 fails because 86400 is below 172800 seconds. Every-control execution closure is also uncertified. No governedIssuance is authored; periodic reconciliation with attestation-only supervision takes precedence and yields unbounded-reconciled.
